decisions.reason: A flagship reference electrometer at the core of the firm's dosimetry competence, featured on the home page in both years, performs above aspiration and needs no problemistic search.
The risk management software extends the firm's integrated QA direction and still has its own page after two years, and an expanding firm has the slack to keep developing its uncertain returns.
The CT phantom builds on established imaging QA and fits the new imaging flagship line, so it is low-risk and consistent with the firm's aspirations.
The mammography phantom is distant from the core, but it belongs to the imaging QA expansion, and while the firm is growing with slack, management will tolerate its early uncertainty.

The full field mammography phantom overlaps with Product D and is distant from the core, so it is the most likely candidate for consolidation, but at this early stage the firm's slack and imaging strategy favour keeping it.
This flagship multi-model imaging QA line represents the firm's strategic direction and receives strong commitment.
